SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT A.BUYER, A.QUOTATION_NO, A.QUOTATION_SEQ, A.REVISION FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_RE_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'LTAL') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER , A.QUOTATION_NO , A.QUOTATION_SEQ , A.REVISION , A.DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION , A.UNIT_MEASURE , A.DELIVERY_LT , A.UNIT_PRICE , A.MAKER_NAME , A.ADD_USER_ID , A.ADD_USER_NAME , A.ADD_USER_DEPT_CODE , A.KEY_1 AS PLANT , A.KEY_2 AS CATEG_ID , 'N' AS IF_FLAG , 'N' AS REG_FLAG FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_RE_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_RE_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_RE_SEND A SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND QUOTATION_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' AND QUOTATION_SEQ = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_SEQ$' AND REVISION = '$G_RS.REVISION$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
